verdict.rationale: Featurebase unifies support conversations (in-app, Slack, Discord, email) into one inbox and offers integrations plus a feedback API/webhooks that could feed captured requests into the system (docs-11, docs-4, docs-28, docs-29), covering support-ticket and chat capture. However there is no evidence of automatic capture from sales calls (e.g., call-recording/CRM integrations or NLP extraction of feedback from transcripts). Missing for 10: sales-call feedback capture/integration, explicit automated extraction of feedback mentions from conversations rather than manual/API-driven creation.
